summary: Customer enquiry about in-line spectroscopy for tracking protein concentration in a dairy whey stream before a concentration stage, with changing turbidity and laboratory reference.

facts_stated.text: The process is a dairy process.
The process includes a relatively clear whey stream.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: includes a relatively clear whey stream

facts_stated.text: The whey stream is before a concentration stage.
The stream can become more turbid under some operating conditions.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: The stream can become more turbid under some operating conditions

facts_stated.text: Laboratory results are used as the reference.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: with laboratory results used as the reference

targets.enquiry_quote: track protein concentration as the stream changes

heterogeneous.enquiry_quote: The stream can become more turbid under some operating conditions

customer_premises.claim: Spectroscopy can track protein concentration as the stream changes.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: whether spectroscopy can track protein concentration as the stream changes

customer_premises.claim: A first measurement concept can handle the turbidity change.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: first measurement concept that handles this change

customer_premises.claim: Laboratory results are a suitable reference.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: with laboratory results used as the reference

customer_premises.claim: A first measurement concept can be provided before all deciding facts are known.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: We need a first measurement concept

unknowns: Target species and range: which protein(s) and the protein concentration range.
Matrix and interferences: whey composition, fat, solids, cleaning agents, and other components.
Physical state and optical behaviour: degree, range, and time course of turbidity changes.
Temperature and pressure: process temperature, pressure, and their variation.
Installation point and distance: exact location before the concentration stage, pipe or flow-cell dimensions, flow rate, and fiber length.
Cleaning and fouling: CIP compatibility, fouling rate, and maintenance requirements.
Required accuracy and response time: allowable error, measurement frequency, and response time.
Reference method: laboratory method details, sampling frequency, sample handling, and uncertainty.
Operating conditions causing turbidity: which conditions and how often they occur.
Concentration stage details: type, operating parameters, and how they affect the stream.
